name: ION Core Boardbag for Pump Foil Board 3'10
short_description: ION Pump Foil Single Boardbag Core is a boardbag for pump foil boards, made for everyday transport and storage. The 5 mm foam padding helps protect your board from typical knocks and abrasion, while the Velcro opening at the bottom lets you store the board without removing the mast.
description:
Everyday protection for your pump foil board

ION Pump Foil Single Boardbag Core is designed for regular use - from transporting your board to the spot to keeping it protected between sessions. The outer shell is made from recycled PET fabric with a PU coating, offering solid resistance to daily wear while helping protect the board from dirt, scuffs and minor damage.

Store your board with the mast attached

One of the most practical details is the Velcro opening on the bottom, which allows you to pack your foil board without taking the mast off. This saves time and makes handling the gear much easier, especially if you often move your board around fully assembled.

Protection from impacts and heat build-up

The bag uses 5 mm foam padding to reduce the risk of damage during transport and day-to-day handling. The off-white PE material on the outside bottom helps keep the inside cooler, which is useful when the bag is left in the sun for a while.

Easy handling and better organization

Handles on the side and top make the bag easier to carry in different situations. It is also compatible with a shoulder strap attached via carabiners. Two outside pockets and one inside pocket give you dedicated space for screws, tools and other small essentials, so everything stays together and easy to find.

More responsible materials

ION Pump Foil Single Boardbag Core uses recycled materials, including Waste2Wear® fabric. It is a sensible option for riders who want practical protection and more thoughtful material choices at the same time.

name: F-ONE TITAN 2 Foil Mast Foot
short_description: F-ONE TITAN Mast Foot V2 is the connecting part that makes F-ONE aluminum masts compatible with TITAN V2 fuselages and wings. Made from 6061 aluminum and CNC-machined for high precision, it provides a secure, stiff, and reliable connection throughout the foil setup.
description:
What this part is for

The TITAN Mast Foot V2 is fitted into the lower end of an F-ONE aluminum mast and allows it to connect with fuselages and front wings using the TITAN V2 system. It is a key component for riders building a consistent and dependable foil setup within the F-ONE range.

Precision and durability

This part is made from high-grade 6061 aluminum, CNC-machined with great accuracy, and fully anodized. As a result, the connection is precise, corrosion-resistant, and well suited for regular use on the water.

Stiff connection and better overall feel

The TITAN 2 system improves stiffness, efficiency, and confidence at the junction between the mast and foil. In practice, this means a more direct feel underfoot, better response from the setup, and a more connected behavior on the water. The adapter is inserted into the lower end of the mast and secured with two M6x25 mm countersunk screws.

The Mast Top Plate is designed to mount an F-ONE aluminum mast onto foil boards using the Twin-Tracks system. It is a practical solution for riders who want a compatible and stable setup without needing additional adaptors.

Precise construction and secure connection

Faster assembly and solid durability

The aluminum used offers very good mechanical properties and natural corrosion resistance, while all contact areas with other metals or carbon parts are properly protected against galvanic reaction.

name: Rear wing Monobloc F-ONE PUMPING 200 XXS
short_description: F-ONE Monobloc Tail Pumping XXS 200 is a rear foil wing built for dock starts and long pump sessions , where efficiency , glide , and smooth flight retention matter most. With its 7.6 aspect ratio , Monobloc construction , and High Modulus Carbon layup , this tail delivers strong carry, high stiffness, and a more direct overall feel.
description:
Who this tail is for

The Monobloc Tail Pumping XXS 200 was designed for riders looking for a rear wing focused primarily on pumping, dock starts, and extending flight as much as possible. It is a strong option for riders who want more glide from their setup, lower energy loss, and more efficient speed retention between each movement.

Glide and pumping efficiency

The biggest strength of this tail is its strong pumping efficiency and smooth carry. Its character helps maintain flight longer, make better use of rider input, and move more efficiently through flat sections. That is exactly why it works so well in setups built for dock start and pump foil use.

Monobloc construction and a more connected setup

The one-piece Monobloc construction improves stiffness and reduces turbulence by removing extra connection points and creating a cleaner water flow around the part. In practice, this translates into a foil that feels more stable, faster, and smoother on the water. Another advantage is easier assembly, as this system removes two screws compared to more traditional designs.

HM Carbon and increased stiffness

This tail uses High Modulus Carbon fiber, which increases stiffness and improves the reliability of the whole part. As a result, the rear wing delivers more direct response, better feedback, and more consistent behavior while pumping. That matters especially when maximum efficiency and repeatable performance are the priority in every session.

name: F-ONE Front wing + rear wing JAM HM CARBON
short_description: Set F-ONE JAM HM Carbon (front wing) + F-ONE Monobloc Tail Pumping XXS 200 (rear wing) for pump foiling and dock starts – easy take-off, low drag and long glide at low speeds
description:
Purpose and rider profile

This front wing + rear wing set is built primarily for dock starts and long pump foiling sessions. It’s a strong choice if you want high efficiency at low speeds, easier lift-off and the ability to keep flying longer without maximum effort every second. In practice, it can also work for wingfoil and light downwind conditions where low-speed lift and efficiency matter most.

Front wing: JAM HM Carbon – low-speed efficiency

The F-ONE JAM is designed to be highly effective during pumping: a few dynamic pumps are enough to get up and stabilize into flight. It doesn’t lose speed instantly even if you briefly stop pumping, which makes learning easier and extends flight time. Its large surface area and AR 10 support long glide and progressive lift, while the optimized geometry helps reduce induced drag.

Rear wing included: Monobloc Tail Pumping XXS 200 – energy return and low drag

The set includes the F-ONE Monobloc Tail Pumping in size XXS 200. This stabilizer is tuned for maximum energy return while pumping: it features a very small surface, AR 7.6 and low drag, helping you maintain speed and glide even during brief pauses. The reduced area provides instant feedback and precise control for technical pump foiling and dock starts.

Construction and foil feel (monobloc / pre-preg / TITAN)

The JAM HM Carbon uses a monobloc construction made with pre-preg technology and High Modulus Carbon, delivering stiffness, consistent feedback and strong load transfer during dynamic pumping. The TITAN connection allows compatibility with both aluminum and carbon masts within the F-ONE foil system. The one-piece monobloc rear wing increases stiffness, reduces turbulence and removes extra screws, resulting in cleaner performance and faster setup.

page_title: Front wing F-ONE JAM TITAN 2 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Front wing F-ONE JAM TITAN 2
short_description: PUMP FOIL / DOCKSTART / LIGHT WIND F-ONE JAM is a front foil wing designed mainly for dock starts and pump foiling , offering very early lift-off , long glide , and high efficiency at low speed . Its generous surface area, aspect ratio of 10 , and TITAN 2 connection help it rise out of the water easily, carry speed for a long time, and make the most of every bit of input energy. It is a strong choice for riders who want to pump efficiently, but also ride in light wind, on small swells, or in marginal conditions.
description:
Who this foil is for

The JAM was designed first and foremost for dock starts and pump foiling, where quick lift-off, long glide, and maximum efficiency at low speed matter most. It is a foil that works both for riders getting into pump foiling and for more advanced users looking for an efficient wing for long pumping sessions and riding in minimal conditions. Thanks to its characteristics, it also performs well for wingfoiling and SUP downwind in light wind, and even for surf foiling on very small swells.

Very easy take-off and long glide

The JAM’s biggest strength is the way it combines easy take-off with very long glide. After just a few pumps, the foil can rise out of the water and keep flying smoothly, and even after a short pause in pumping it still keeps carrying. That is exactly what makes it such a good option for dock starts and flatwater pumping, where every bit of energy counts. The foil does not require constant, nervous effort - it gives the rider more time and a bigger margin to stay in rhythm.

TITAN 2 connection and a more direct feel

The new TITAN 2 connection improves stiffness, efficiency, and confidence at the junction between the mast and foil. The system uses two M8 screws and has been reinforced in this key structural area, allowing the whole setup to react more precisely and deliver a more direct feel underfoot. In practice, this means better energy transfer while pumping, fewer losses, and more consistent foil behavior. The added stiffness also helps make better use of glide and reduce drag.

High efficiency at low speed and the ability to accelerate

Its high aspect ratio of 10, refined profile, and carefully tuned angle of attack help reduce drag and improve the wing’s efficiency. As a result, the JAM performs extremely well at low speed, but can also accelerate noticeably when needed. That matters because this foil is not just a pumping machine - it also gives riders the option to go faster, use it for light wind wingfoiling, or enjoy small waves with ease. One of its biggest strengths is the way it combines lift, glide, and useful speed.

Not just for pumping

Although the JAM was developed mainly for dock starts and pump foiling, its use goes beyond that. The brand clearly shows that thanks to its strong low-speed efficiency and ability to build speed, the foil also works very well for wingfoiling and downwind riding in lighter conditions. It can also be an interesting choice for surf foiling in micro-swells, where easy flight retention and efficient use of small wave energy are especially important. It is a specialized foil, but at the same time surprisingly versatile.

Refined construction and stiffness

The JAM also benefits from construction solutions that improve precision and direct response. High Modulus fiber is around 1.5 times stiffer than standard carbon, which allows the foil to perform better in both bending and torsion without becoming overly harsh. The Monobloc Front Wing construction integrates the front wing with the fuselage, removing a connection point in one of the most highly loaded parts of the setup. In practice, this means greater stiffness, fewer unwanted micro-movements, and a more direct transfer of rider input to the foil.

Sizes and the character of each version

The JAM is available in three sizes: 1400, 1600, and 1900 cm². The 1400 cm² version is a very good choice for more experienced dock start and pump foil riders, as well as for riders starting out in SUP downwind, light wind wingfoiling, or surf foiling on very small swells. The 1600 cm² size works very well for wingfoiling and SUP foiling in marginal conditions, for riders who already know how to dock start, and for those learning SUP downwind. The 1900 cm² version is the best option for dock starts, pumping on flat water, and for heavier riders who need more lift and even easier take-offs.

name: Front wing Duotone AMP 2.0 SLS
short_description: PUMP / DOCK START Duotone AMP 2.0 SLS is a front wing designed for pump foiling and dock start , built to maximize pumping efficiency and glide with minimal rider effort. Its updated profile with a higher lift-to-drag ratio improves projection and reduces drag, helping riders stay on foil longer while maintaining smooth, efficient pumping rhythm.
description:
A foil designed for pump foiling

The AMP 2.0 SLS represents the next generation of Duotone pump foiling wings. Its design focuses on efficiency – allowing each pump to generate more forward projection and helping riders maintain flight with less physical effort.

More glide and projection

The new wing profile increases the lift-to-drag ratio, improving glide performance and making it easier to stay high on the foil. This allows riders to maintain speed between pumps and keep a smooth rhythm during longer runs.

Easy starts and forgiving behavior

The AMP 2.0 SLS also offers a friendly take-off character. Its stall-friendly design makes dock starts easier and helps riders lift onto foil without requiring aggressive pumping technique. Once flying, the wing maintains stable and predictable behavior.

Lively turning feel

A lower sweep angle moves the center of lift further forward, improving pumping efficiency while also making the wing feel more dynamic. This gives the AMP 2.0 SLS a lively yet intuitive turning response during pumping sessions.

SLS construction for energy transfer

The wing uses carefully tuned carbon layups optimized for each size. This ensures the right balance between stiffness and flex, helping transfer rider energy more efficiently into forward motion.

Designed to work with H stabilizers

The AMP 2.0 SLS is designed to pair with H stabilizers, which complement its glide and pumping characteristics. Different stabilizer options allow riders to tune the setup for either maximum efficiency or easier progression.
